caption: The drawing features a single armchair positioned centrally on a plain background. The armchair has an ornately carved wooden frame with intricate detailing on the crest rail and arms. The seat, backrest, and armrests are upholstered in a reddish-pink fabric. The legs of the chair are tapered and decorated with subtle carved accents. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small, faded pencil sketch detail of an ornamental motif, possibly a decorative element from the same furniture style, resembling a dragon’s or animal’s head and leaf design. The majority of the composition is dominated by empty space, with the chair rendered in color and detail, and the decorative sketch rendered only in light pencil.
title: Arm Chair
